pillars.label: Content Data Quality
pillars.about: The data values themselves: whether what was recorded can be trusted and used again.

pillars.label: Technical Data Quality
pillars.about: The files and formats that carry the data: whether they open, validate and stay usable.

pillars.label: Metadata Quality
pillars.about: The description around the data: whether others can find it, understand it and judge it.
